intro: The KPK LsETH Carry Fund earns a carry on LsETH through collateralised lending on Morpho. LsETH is supplied as collateral on the LsETH/USDC market, and the borrowed USDC goes into two KPK-curated USDC vaults. Holders keep full ETH exposure and earn the staking yield plus the spread between the vaults' yield and the borrow rate, accruing in LsETH.

LsETH is Liquid Collective's liquid staking token, minted and redeemed through approved platforms such as Coinbase Prime, Figment and Bitcoin Suisse, as well as traded permissionlessly on DEXes. Deposits and redemptions are in LsETH, on Upshift's vault infrastructure with KPK as curator.

Audit 1219 (23 Aug) changed the loan vault split, not the band. Left grey on purpose: 5 Aug 15:53 to 10 Aug 14:23. Audit 450 saved repay_below 1.3 and borrow_above 1.9 then, but the position sat at health factor 1.93 to 1.99, above that 1.9, for almost 5 days with no Borrow, so the setting was not in force. To draw it anyway, add {"from": "2026-08-05 15:53", "to": "2026-08-10 14:23", "repay_below": 1.3, "borrow_above": 1.9}. backtest.summary: Backtest cross-check: +2.11% a year at 75% LTV over 180 days
backtest.text: Over the 180 days to 30 Jul 2026, on reconstructed onchain borrow rates and the vault's realised share price, this strategy at 75% LTV averaged +2.11% net over LsETH: monthly range 1.32% to 3.17%, with the 1.5% floor cleared on 75% of days. That run used deeper 86%-LLTV proxy markets, because LsETH/USDC had no rate history at the time; its own 45 days since have averaged 4.01% borrow at 89% utilisation, against the proxy's 4.01%.

health_factor_manager._readme: Live KPK Agents config for this position. The page converts each health factor to LTV at the market's live LLTV.

risk.title: Automated in a band, alerted on carry, bounded onchain
risk.lede: KPK runs the position with deterministic agents. They act only through onchain permissions and within the settings KPK gives them: when a predefined condition is met, they execute a predefined action. The health factor manager keeps the loan in its band; the other agents move LsETH between the vault and the trading subaccount and propose the NAV. Two exit agents, one per KPK USDC vault, withdraw the fund's USDC from a vault back to the trading subaccount when Hypernative flags that vault or a market it lends into. A negative carry goes to KPK's risk team for review.
steps: The agents read the position's health factor and the LsETH waiting in the vault. Hypernative watches the carry: the two vaults' yield against the LsETH/USDC borrow rate.

Rules set in advance. Inside the health factor band, {repay_below} to {borrow_above}, nothing happens. Outside it, the health factor manager acts. A negative spread raises an alert to KPK's risk team.
The agent sends the transaction itself: it repays to a health factor of {repay_to}, or borrows back to {borrow_to}, in steps of at least {min_change} USDC.

On the operator Safe, KPK's agents can call only the two LsETH transfer functions, through a Zodiac Roles module. NAV updates need KPK's and Upshift's signatures and stay within the vault owner's maximum change.

auto.title: The health factor manager and the exit agents
auto.body: Below a health factor of {repay_below} the agent repays to {repay_to}; above {borrow_above} it borrows back to {borrow_to} and deposits the new USDC {split_yield}/{split_rwa} into the two KPK USDC vaults, in steps of at least {min_change} USDC. At the market's {lltv} LLTV those levels are {repay_below_ltv}, {repay_to_ltv}, {borrow_to_ltv} and {borrow_above_ltv} LTV. The exit agents act in this layer too: on a hack or exploit alert on collateral a KPK USDC vault lends against, an oracle ownership change on KPK USDC Yield's markets, or a vault-level alert (a gate change, an owner or curator change, or a share-price drop), the vault's exit agent withdraws the fund's USDC from that vault back to the trading subaccount.

human.title: Negative carry goes to the risk team
human.body: Hypernative watches the spread, the two vaults' share-price yield minus the LsETH/USDC borrow rate as a 6-hour median, and alerts KPK's risk team when it turns negative. The team reviews each alert.

agents.name: Health factor manager
agents.body: Keeps the position inside its band. Below a health factor of {repay_below} it repays to {repay_to}; above {borrow_above} it borrows back to {borrow_to}. Each change is at least {min_change} USDC, and new borrowing goes {split_yield}/{split_rwa} into KPK USDC Yield and KPK USDC Yield RWA.

agents.name: Deposit agents
agents.body: Move newly subscribed LsETH from the Upshift vault to the trading subaccount, and supply idle LsETH there as collateral on Morpho.

agents.name: Withdraw agent
agents.body: Moves LsETH back from the trading subaccount to the vault to pay redemptions. Hypernative alerts KPK on each redemption, so this runs when the vault's own LsETH is short.

agents.name: NAV agent
agents.short: proposes the NAV twice a week
agents.body: KPK's NAV Calculator gives the fund's NAV at every block, and anyone can query it onchain. The Upshift vault records it twice a week: the NAV agent checks it against an independent valuation and proposes the update on Mondays and Thursdays. Upshift co-signs each update, bounded by a maximum change set by the vault owner.

agents.name: Agents on the KPK USDC vaults
agents.body: Both KPK USDC vaults run KPK's rebalance, exit and monitoring agents, which exit a market on a pause, exploit or oracle change. They act on the vaults, not on the fund's own loan.

agents.name: Exit agents
agents.short: pull USDC out of a vault on an alert
agents.body: One per KPK USDC vault, each acting with no human approval needed. On a hack or exploit alert on collateral the vault lends against, an oracle ownership change (KPK USDC Yield only), or a vault-level alert (a gate change, an owner or curator change, or a share-price drop), it withdraws the fund's USDC from that vault back to the trading subaccount.

permissions.title: Two parties own the vault
permissions.body: The vault owner is a 3-of-4 Safe with two KPK seats, the KPK curation Safe and the KPK Security Council, and two Upshift seats, so neither side can change the vault alone.

permissions.title: Only the operator moves LsETH
permissions.body: Moving LsETH between the vault and the trading subaccount, and writing the NAV, are reserved to the operator, a 2-of-2 Safe with one KPK and one Upshift signer. KPK's agents call only the two transfer functions, through a Zodiac Roles module on that Safe.

permissions.title: Both sides sign every NAV
permissions.body: Each NAV update needs both signatures and is bounded by a maximum change set by the vault owner.

scaling._readme: How the fund scales, after the risk section. The fund's size is capped by the USDC it can borrow against LsETH, so the rows are borrow venues, not fund sizes (no sourced size targets). status is one of: live, under discussion, candidate (anything else renders neutral). Aave rows state the real forum status: V3 has a temp check (passed on Snapshot) and an ARFC thread, no ARFC Snapshot vote and no AIP; V4 has no thread, so it is a candidate, not planned. as_of is the date the Aave status was last checked against the Aave governance forum and Snapshot; update it with the copy. Placeholders as above.
scaling.title: Sized by borrowing capacity, not by date
scaling.intro: The fund can grow only as far as the USDC it can borrow against LsETH, today one Morpho market. Aave listings would add venues; they are the Aave DAO's decision.

main_risks._readme: One row per key risk in the fund docs: the risk, then how it is handled. Facts only from this page or the docs. Placeholders as above.
main_risks.title: Main risks, and how they are handled
rows: Holders keep full exposure to the ETH price.
ETH exposure is the product itself: the fund earns its carry on top of LsETH and its staking yield. The loan runs at a {target_ltv} LTV target against an {lltv} LLTV.
ETH falls faster than the position can be deleveraged.

Below a health factor of {repay_below} ({repay_below_ltv} LTV), the health factor manager repays USDC until it is back at {repay_to} ({repay_to_ltv}), with no human approval needed. The market liquidates at its {lltv} LLTV.
The USDC borrow rate rises above what the two KPK USDC vaults earn.
Hypernative watches the spread as a 6-hour median and alerts KPK's risk team when it turns negative. The team reviews each alert.
Validator slashing and redemption delays at Liquid Collective.

Reviewed under KPK's Risk Framework and redeemable through approved platforms such as Coinbase Prime, Figment and Bitcoin Suisse, as well as traded permissionlessly on DEXes. The market values LsETH at its redemption value, so a DEX discount does not move the health factor; a slashing loss does, and the health factor manager acts on it.
KPK USDC Yield RWA lends against tokenised real-world assets, mainly private credit and tokenised funds.

It lends only in markets other curators also supply, with a cap on each market, against collateral that has passed KPK's Risk Framework. Its exit agent withdraws the fund's USDC on a hack or exploit alert on one of those markets, or on a vault-level alert.
Thin liquidity in the two KPK USDC vaults can delay deleveraging and redemptions.

KPK curates both vaults and runs rebalance, exit and monitoring agents on them around the clock, which keep allocations within their caps and liquidity buffers. On an alert, the exit agents bring the fund's USDC back to the trading subaccount.
Manipulation, staleness or failure of a price feed, which would affect collateral valuation and liquidations.

The market prices LsETH at its redemption value (Chainlink's LsETH/ETH Exchange Rate feed) times Chainlink's ETH/USD, so a thin DEX market cannot move it or trigger liquidations. The NAV agent checks each NAV against DeBank. Hypernative alerts KPK if the oracle has not updated in 25 hours, and an oracle ownership change on a KPK USDC Yield market triggers its exit agent.
Upshift's vault contracts, Morpho, Liquid Collective and the KPK-curated vaults.

Collateral and venues are reviewed under KPK's Risk Framework, more than 150 checks across 12 risk dimensions. A 3-of-4 Safe with two KPK and two Upshift seats owns the vault, and KPK's agents can call only the two LsETH transfer functions on the operator Safe, through a Zodiac Roles module.

tiles.detail: subscriptions, up to the vault's 10,000 LsETH cap
redemptions: instant against LsETH held in the vault; larger amounts once KPK moves LsETH back from the trading subaccount, normally within 2 days

terms.note: Subscribe in LsETH and redeem for LsETH, both at the last recorded share price. Subscribed LsETH is then moved to the trading subaccount and supplied as collateral.
